title: Longest Palindrome by Concatenating Two Letter Words
goal: Build the longest palindrome by arranging selected two-letter words.
strategy: A nonsymmetric word pairs with its reverse on the opposite side. Symmetric words pair with themselves, and at most one leftover symmetric word can occupy the center.
